mapper.select: SELECT PROCUREMENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT) AS totalBudget, SUM(ACTUAL_AMOUNT) AS totalActual, CASE WHEN SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(ACTUAL_AMOUNT) / SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS savingRate FROM TBL_PROCUREMENT_PROJECT AND COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} GROUP BY PROCUREMENT_TYPE
